description: Price lists on the merchant's Shopify store (a market's or B2B catalog's own prices). action list, get (id, with its fixed prices), set_prices (id, prices [{variantId, price, compareAtPrice}] in the list's currency, up to 250), remove_prices (id, variantIds: back to the converted price).
